scope: Production native main, copied stage process spawn, supervisor, cache and observer with a fake C compiler entry/counter; selected unmodified real Goose runtime, no whole compiler executable or Goose dispatcher qualification

predecessor.policy: Original source hashes, results and pending entries remain historical; this record supplies the successor native source pins and rerun.

runtime.origin_mode: runtime-observer; emitted runtime has no compiler source algorithm

tools.cc_version:
clang version 23.1.4
Target: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/bin

compile_flags.wrapper: Includes selected runtime.c unchanged, then tracked native/tests/worker_oom_test.c to reach real internal registry calloc. Production main.c is compiled separately, with only its main symbol renamed.

sanitizer_environment.leak_scope: Forked/killed heaps are intentionally discarded; explicit parent FD counts and child reaping checked. LeakSanitizer heap accounting not claimed.

protocol.copied_packet_protocol: BLOTJOB2, version2, unchanged Goose readFrame/writeFrame schema
protocol.capability: Fresh SOCK_SEQPACKET endpoint per candidate, transferred over its authenticated control channel and passed only to its stage exec children; token alone grants no authority. Separate from worker stdout and adoption control.
protocol.marker: Existing fixed32-byte token-bound OOM record; only an explicit allocation callback emits the valid test markers. Exit125 alone has no OOM meaning.
protocol.bootstrap: Private native argv suffix is validated and consumed before goose_init; visible worker args remain exactly --worker. Capability immediately restored CLOEXEC.
protocol.completion_order: Close all candidate-owned worker inputs, join normal EOF/cleanup, close candidate capability, seal reply, FINISH/READY, drain capability through EOF before baseline retirement. Optional cache publish still occurs only after COMMIT.
protocol.baseline: Candidate detaches inherited baseline worker handles without signalling baseline workers; baseline stage children retain token0, never later request tokens.
protocol.seqpacket_edge: Linux zero-length seqpacket messages can return0 just like EOF, including when sender closes later. SO_PASSCRED marks real messages; only credential-free zero bytes plus POLLHUP counts as EOF. Empty/short/wrong-token records are ordinary failure.
